name: gosx-large-feature
original:
add(runtime): event-mode live binds, region growth modes, hub backoff

- data-gosx-live-mode="event" applies a matched gosx:hub:event's own object payload directly to the root's data-gosx-live-bind keys with no fetch, so data-gosx-live-src becomes optional there and only serves the manual window.__gosx.live.refresh path; a src-less record treats every fetch trigger as a silent no-op instead of a network error.
- data-gosx-region-mode="append|prepend" grows a region beside its existing children rather than re-mounting the whole subtree, so a tape or board never re-initializes rows it already has. data-gosx-region-key drops a fragment node whose key matches a present child, and data-gosx-region-cursor fills a {cursor} token in the URL off an already-rendered child (first in prepend, last otherwise) — the growth-mode counterpart to {value}. A fully deduplicated fragment inserts nothing and emits no gosx:region:after.
- Hub reconnects back off exponentially from 500 ms, doubling to a 15 s cap with up to 25 percent jitter, and reset the moment a socket actually opens; the attempt count is carried through connectHub so retries keep climbing instead of pinning to the base delay, and a second close can no longer stack an overlapping timer. This spreads out the thundering-herd reconnect storm after a server restart.
- The live-bind attribute target maps are now built with Object.create(null) and probed through hasOwnProperty: an author-controlled bind target such as constructor, __proto__, or hasOwnProperty no longer resolves truthy through Object.prototype, so the attribute allowlist's decisions stop depending on which check happens to run first.
- Go-side contracts expose the new surface: RegionModeAttr/RegionKeyAttr/RegionCursorAttr with matching RegionOptions Mode/Key/Cursor fields, and NavigationLiveModeAttr.
- New coverage for region append/prepend and dedupe, event-mode binds, and reconnect backoff, plus prototype-name refusal cases in the attribute-bind test; bundle size budgets raised and the bootstrap chunks rebuilt for the larger navigation/regions/hubs runtime.
- CHANGELOG and the runtime and hubs docs pages describe the event-mode, region growth, countdown retargeting, and reconnect-backoff contracts.

Refs #217
